hero_lead: Free functional fitness for every body. Come as you are. Leave a little stronger.
intro_title: Fitness that helps you in real life.
intro_p1: Moving with Monique is our free fitness class. We do functional fitness — moves that help you every day. Think lifting, carrying, bending, and balance. These are the things real life asks of you.
intro_p2: Every move can be made easier or harder. So the class works for everyone. Seniors, beginners, and pros all train side by side. You go at your own pace.
intro_p3: Monique leads every class. She keeps it fun, safe, and friendly. You will never feel out of place here. You just show up, and we take care of the rest.
step1: Go to the {{settings.venue}} schedule using the button below.
step2: Find Saturday's "Free Community Workout — Functional Fitness Class" at 11 AM. Tap Reserve.
step3: New here? Pick "Non-member." Then pick "Free Class — Drop-In Visit."
step4: Enter your email. Fill out the short form and sign the waivers.
step5: Make a password so next time is quick.
